correctness.rationale: For all positive voter-type populations a,b, supported candidates and 1<=k<=|C|, Pareto optimality forces every shared candidate to be selected whenever a private winner exists; hence h=min(k,|A∩B|). If h=k, reserves and payments 1/(k+1) satisfy all P1-P4. Otherwise all losers are private: EJR+ is precisely n_i<(h+y_i+1)q for each type with private losers. In any core+ payment system P1/P2 imply individual r>=1/(u_i+1), giving necessity. For sufficiency, put rho_i*=q/n_i when n_i>=q and a loser exists, otherwise 1; private winners absorb up to y_i q, leaving D_i*=max(0,n_i-(y_i+1)q) for active types. Strict scalar inequalities give D_i*<h n_i rho_i*; when both deficits are positive D_A*+D_B*=(h-2)q<hq, and when only one is positive it is <hq. Small positive rational reserve perturbations preserve capacities and give strict P3. Equal payments over selected classes give P1, P2, P4. The non-Pareto (2 voters, 4 candidates, 3 seats) example has EJR+ but requires reserve sum >=3/4>2/3 and so is not core+. Independently constructed LP checks 6,912 finite aggregate configurations, 6,332 feasible and 580 obstructed, matching strict quota criteria; these numerical finite checks corroborate but do not prove unbounded claim.
residual_risks: The proof relies on BGP Theorem 3.2 for equivalence of core+ and payment certificates, as is explicit in the claim.
The independent finite LP checker uses numerical optimization, so boundary strictness and unbounded domain are established by algebraic proof, not its tolerance.
No claim for three types or Droop quota.

value.rationale: This is a natural infinite two-approval-type domain where shared and private candidates genuinely interact. A precise per-committee equivalence between easy EJR+ tests and stronger fractional coalition stability, with a constructive rational payment witness and sharp two-voter Pareto boundary, resolves a meaningful classification rather than restating core+ existence, a routine parameter substitution, or recomputing a table. It does not require a larger general theorem to be valuable.
residual_risks: No claim that the two-type membership test extends to three or more types or to Droop quota.
Usefulness of explicit payments is limited to supported candidates and Pareto-efficient full committees.

limitations: Best-of-knowledge novelty only; unindexed earlier equivalent remains possible.
Finite LP checks do not replace universal proof or exact strictness; proof is independent of numerical optimization.
